warnings: Fuel quantities and expenditure are conditional on assumed locations and availability; not driving instructions.
The mathematical scenario does not establish reachable fuel stops or a 500-mile driving guarantee.
A locality reference point does not establish where any associated station is located.
Entrances, access detours, fuel availability and additional mileage are excluded and unverified.
Positions interpolate within provider steps, or use scaled geometry when steps are absent. US endpoints do not ensure the whole route stays in the US.
CSV snapshot prices remain attached to OPIS identities; current prices and the initial tank cost are unknown.
